Boosters
Looking for something that isn't here? Visit the category for all booster-related articles.

Claimed in various Warbonds, Boosters are effects beneficial to your squad that you can add to your loadout before dropping into a mission. They provide extra health, stamina, or a tactical advantage in the battlefield. Each Helldiver can equip their own booster up to a maximum of four unique ones per mission.

Icon Booster Description Warbond Price
Hellpod Space Optimization Helldivers come out of the Hellpod fully stocked on Ammo, Grenades and Stims. Helldivers Mobilize 15 Medals
Vitality Enhancement Provides minor damage reduction from all sources for all Helldivers Helldivers Mobilize 20 Medals
UAV Recon Booster Increases all Helldivers' effective radar range. Helldivers Mobilize 40 Medals
Stamina Enhancement Increases all Helldivers' stamina capacity and recovery. Helldivers Mobilize 75 Medals
Muscle Enhancement Allows Helldivers to traverse difficult terrain with ease. Helldivers Mobilize 70 Medals
Increased Reinforcement Budget Increases the number of available reinforcements. Helldivers Mobilize 150 Medals
Flexible Reinforcement Budget Reduces time until new reinforcements are granted once they've been depleted. Steeled Veterans 75 Medals
Localization Confusion Increases the time between enemy encounters. Cutting Edge 18 Medals
Expert Extraction Pilot Lowers the time it takes for the extraction shuttle to reach the extraction beacon. Democratic Detonation 55 Medals
Motivational Shocks Allows all Helldivers to recover faster after being slowed by an attack, such as acid. Does not mitigate “area effects,” such as EMS strikes. Polar Patriots 15 Medals
Experimental Infusion In addition to restoring health, Stims temporarily increase movement speed and damage reduction. Viper Commandos 80 Medals
Firebomb Hellpods Lines all Hellpods with volatile incendiaries that detonate upon impact, igniting any units in vicinity of the drop site. Freedom's Flame 60 Medals
Dead Sprint Allows Helldivers to keep sprinting even when they are out of stamina, draining their health instead. Truth Enforcers 35 Medals
Armed Resupply Pods Mounts a modified AR-23 Liberator to all resupply pods, allowing them to double as automatic turrets. Urban Legends 55 Medals
Sample Extricator Large enemies now have a chance of dropping Samples on death. Capped at 10 drops per mission. Borderline Justice 65 Medals
Sample Scanner The Sample scanner gives you a 15% chance to receive twice the Samples on sample pick up. Masters of Ceremony 65 Medals
Stun Pods Exposes Hellpod wiring upon surface contact, stunning any units in the vicinity of the drop site. Force of Law 55 Medals
Concealed Insertion Equips Hellpods to deploy smokescreens on impact, obscuring Helldiver deployment. Redacted Regiment 40 Medals
